## Material at issue

Profile and exact page URL:

Passage, image, claim, or source:

## Requested action

Describe the correction, qualification, source update, or removal requested.

## Supporting evidence

Link public supporting evidence when available. Do not post private identification, addresses, phone numbers, family details, or other sensitive information.

## Relationship to the material

State whether you are the subject, an authorized representative, a rights holder, a source publisher, or another person reporting an issue.

## Urgency or potential harm

Flag an image-rights, privacy, identity, safety, or materially misleading issue that should be prioritized.
